sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 922 of 2024
Petitioner :- Mohd. Jaan And Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. Govt. Civil Secrt. Lko. And Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Seraj Ahmad Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Sachindra Dwivedi Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Sachindra Dwivedi,
Advocate, who has put in appearance on behalf of the respondent no.4.
This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-

"Issue a writ , order or direction in the nature of Certiorari to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 8.1.2024 lodged at Police Station Reusa, District Sitapur, registered at Case Crime No.0016/2024 Under Section 452/376-D/506/313 I.P.C., contained in Annexure No.1."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the impugned F.I.R. has been lodged by respondent no.4 against the petitioner just for harassment and with oblique motive, hence the impugned F.I.R. is liable to be quashed.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for quashing of the First Information Report and produced before this Court written instructions dated 07.02.2024 sent by Sri Ajay Kumar Singh, Sub Inspector/ Investigating Officer, P.S. Reusa, Sitapur along with a copy of the Case Diary.
Instructions and the copy of the Case Diary are kept on record.

This Court has gone through the contents of the F.I.R. and also the instructions available with the learned A.G.A. including the copy of the Case Diary, which contains the statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. given to the Court concerned.

After having examined the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned F.I.R. as also the instructions, we are of the opinion that the impugned F.I.R. discloses cognizable offence by the petitioner, hence, no interference is called for by this Court in its extraordinary power under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing of the F.I.R. or for grant of any interim relief to the petitioners and accordingly, the present writ petition is dismissed.

Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Rahul  Mohd. Jaan And Others vs State Of U.P Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17863435/
